name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.log.LogTask
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. Android creates this BigBrother provider during app startup; it initializes the local log store used by the diagnostic log screen.
disableEffect: BigBrother's local log store will not be initialized, so its diagnostic log history may be missing; normal app features continue to work.
